mainEntity.name: What is Travel Guard’s Travel Inconvenience Benefit coverage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel Inconvenience Benefit coverage is available on Travel Guard’s Preferred and Deluxe travel insurance plans and may provide travelers with a flat-rate payment for certain inconveniences related to covered Unforeseen events which occur on your vacation. Travelers can get paid for a one-time occurrence of each inconvenient event (up to the maximum benefit limit on the plan), which includes flight cancellations, flight delays (past a time frame specified in the plan details) and more events, which can be found listed in your plan.

mainEntity.name: How do I use the Travel Inconvenience Benefit coverage during my trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you experience one of the covered travel inconveniences on your trip, be sure to keep any documentation supporting the inconveniences you experienced so you can file a claim. For help navigating unexpected events during your trip, contact our assistance services team for travel assistance.

mainEntity.name: What documentation do I need to file a claim for Travel Inconvenience?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The specific documentation needed for your Travel Inconvenience Benefits claim will depend on the unforeseen events that you experience on your trip.

Below is a list of documentation that may be required.

- Travel Guard claim form

- Proof of occurrence

There may be additional documents required based on your specific claim. You can start the process of filing a claim online with our claims portal or you can call us directly if you have specific questions.

mainEntity.name: Is Travel Inconvenience Benefits coverage worth it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inconveniences during your trip can put a damper on your mood or even set an unhappy tone for your trip, depending on when they occur. With Travel Guard, there’s a silver lining for these interruptions with Travel Inconvenience Benefits coverage.

mainEntity.name: Can I add the Travel Inconvenience Benefits to my travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel Inconvenience coverage is available on the Preferred.  You can add the Travel Inconvenience Bundle to the Preferred Plan to increase the covered unforeseen events.
